Shortcuts List

LBS has shortcuts to quickly access some of its different tools. This section presents a list of the shortcuts offered by Level Builder Sidekick.

List of LBS shortcuts

Note

Shortcuts are context-dependent. The context in which each shortcut works is defined by its category.

LBS Window

Camera
  Drag camera
  Move camera to origin O
  Adjust camera to viewport A
LBS File (.lbs)
  Save LBS File Ctrl + S
  Open LBS File Ctrl + O
  New LBS File Ctrl + N

Interior layer

While using paint tool
 Paint w/ selected zone
 Erase painted zone
 Create new zone Ctrl +

Exterior layer

Quest layer

Project Window

Bundles
  Create Bundles of each selected asset Alt + B
  Create single Bundle of selected assets Alt + Shift + B
